We are of the view that the decision of the Petitioner to award the implementation of the instant transmission asset to TANTRANSCO on a deposit work basis was a commercial decision taken by the Petitioner. Accordingly, any kind of delay attributable to M/s BHEL being the executing agency engaged by TANTRANSCO, falls within the contractual arrangement entered into between the Petitioner and TANTRANSCO and cannot, by itself, constitute a sufficient ground for condonation of the entire period of delay. 38. In the instant case, TANTRANSCO was entrusted with the execution of the instant transmission asset by the Petitioner on a deposit work basis. The commissioning of the instant transmission asset was delayed on account of the delay in execution by M/s BHEL. In our view, the delay attributable to TANTRANSCO and its executing agency arises out of the contractual arrangement entered into by the Petitioner and, therefore, cannot be regarded as an uncontrollable factor within the meaning of Regulation 22(1)(b) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019. Accordingly, we are not inclined to consider the reasons submitted by the Petitioner for condonation of the delay. 42.
